Title: Powder vs Liquid Hydroponic Nutrients: Mixing, Storage & EC
Description: Powder and liquid feed plants equally at the same nutrient rate. Powder: weigh grams (2.4 g per gallon), keep dry. Liquid: dose mL, keep above freezing. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
